title: Koi Pond
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this Halloween-themed episode, Michael hosts a spooky event at the office, involving costumes, haunted warehouse descriptions, and a koi pond incident. The episode explores Michael’s attempts at holiday messaging, his interactions with colleagues about personal traits, and humorous discussions about a fish and a work appointment, culminating in uncertainties about the koi fish's fate and the significance of the koi pond list item.
